name: blackboard
description: The ticket 12.2 (ADR-014) demonstration of the run-scoped blackboard: shared, versioned key/value memory steps read and write during a run. A draft `llm` step (offline mock, model `mock/sim-1`) publishes its completion text to the blackboard declaratively via its `blackboard` block — pinned so no future compaction (M12.4) can drop it — while its `from: /text` pointer selects exactly the completion text. In parallel a `blackboard_write` step records a plan under key `plan` with a `writer` tag. A join gathers both, then a `capstone` `blackboard_write` writes key `plan` again under a version compare-and-swap guard (`expected_version: 1`, so it lands at v2 only if nothing else moved the key) and reads the pinned `draft_text` head back through `read_key`. Every entry is token-counted with the writing step's counter (the llm step's model tokenizer, the chars/4 fallback for the plain writes) and retained for audit. Runs entirely offline on the mock provider — no API key, no network — so it is the workhorse blackboard fixture for CI. Inspect the result with `ctl blackboard <run-id>` or GET /v1/runs/{id}/blackboard.
